name: Lady Xoc
subtitle: Consort of Yaxchilan
description: Sacrifice your enemies dealing additional damage to enemies under Bleed.
lore: Xoc was a priestess, beseeching the gods to bless her land’s soldiers. After the Shattering, however, she found Omeyocan’s warriors had no advantage over others—not because her gods failed to heed, but because the enemy’s gods held power just as real. Offended, Lady Xoc now raises weapons of her own, wielding magic and blade against worshipers that she deems “false” gods.
divinity_generator: Gain [80] Divinity when defeating an enemy.
